evidence: Static water contact angle (WCA) measurements were carried out ex situ with deionized water in a DataPhysics Contact Angle System (OCA model) equipped with a CCD camera from Teli and a Hamilton 500 μL syringe. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) was performed with a Bruker dimension edge atomic force microscope equipped with an Olympus OMCL-AC160TS-R3 probe. Spectroscopy Ellipsometry (SE) measurements were performed ex situ using a J. A. Woollam RC2 at 65-, 70- and 75-degree incident angles with respect to the substrate normal. Time coordinated X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was performed to avoid air exposure of the analyzed samples. Ex-situ cyclic voltammetry (CV) profiles were carried out with a 0.1 M sodium hydroxide aqueous solution as electrolyte. Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) was employed to quantify the Hf areal density deposited by the Hf N ALD process.
